newsitem.title: USA: Alpine Group Q4 shr $0.14, includes charge.
newsitem.headline: Alpine Group Q4 shr $0.14, includes charge.

text.p: (Dollars in Thousands, Except Per Share Amounts)
NOTES: Full company name Alpine Group Inc.

(A) During the second quarter ended October 31, 1996, Superior Telecom (a subsidiary of the company) completed the sale of 6,900,000 shares of its common stock (representing 49.9% of its total common stock) resulting in the company's ownership of Superior Telecom being reduced to 50.1 percent. Proceeds from the offering and from a refinancing completed shortly prior to the offering were distributed to Alpine in repayment of inter-company debt and as a dividend payment.
In connection with the offering and distribution of proceeds, the company recognized a pre-tax gain of $80.4 million. ($41.4 million, or $2.24 per share, on an after tax basis).

(B) During the three months and year ended April 30, 1997, the company retired debt with a face value of $45.0 million and $176.8 million, respectively. As a result of the debt retirement, the company recognized a $700,000 (or $0.04 per share) and a $20.1 million (or $1.09 per share) loss on the early extinguishment of debt for the three months and year ended April 30, 1997, respectively.

(C) During the quarter ended October 31, 1996, the company entered into an agreement to repurchase for $13.2 million, 160,000 shares of the company's eight percent cumulative convertible senior preferred stock with a par value of $8.0 million. In accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, the transaction was accounted for as a redemption of preferred stock at a premium to carrying value, and as such the net income attributable to common stock for the year ended April 31, 1997 was reduced by $5.2 million (or $0.28 per share).
